welcome.title: Ku soo dhawaaw SafeNeighbor
welcome.mainMessage: SafeNeighbor waxay ku siisaa aqoon iyo awood aad naftaada iyo bulshadaada ugu ilaaliso iyadoo ku baraysa xuquuqdaada, ku siinaysa qoraallo loo adeegsado kulamada ICE, iyo warbixinno sharciyeysan oo bulshada ka yimaada oo ku saabsan la kulanka ICE iyo DHS. App-kan waxaa loo dhisay iyadoo badbaadadaada mudnaanta koowaad la siinayo: duubista iyo xogta badbaadada ee la keydiyo waxaa lagu sirgeliyaa qalabkaaga, hagayaashuna waxay sii ahaanayaan kuwo la heli karo xitaa adigoon internet lahayn, halka warbixinnada bulshada ay wadaagaan oo keliya faahfaahinta guud ee looga baahan yahay in lagu digto dadka kuu dhow.
welcome.communityMessage: Waxaan rumaysneyn in bulshada warkaaga leh ay ka badbaadsan yihiin. Iyadoo la ogaado xuquuqdaada oo midba midka kale taageeraya, waxaan samayn karnaa shabakad gargaar is dhexgal iyo ilaalin.
welcome.pinDescription: Ilaali duubidaada iyo xogtaada adiga oo dejinaya PIN Dejinta Amniga. Waxaad sidoo kale dejin kartaa <1>PIN Khiyaano ah</1> — haddii mar la kugu qasbay inaad furto barnaamijka, PIN khiyaano ahu wuxuu muujiyaa khaznad madhan oo aan lahayn duubis muuqda.
welcome.quote1: Waxaad tahay muwaadin aduunka, oo qaybtiisa; ma aha mid hoos joog ah, laakiin qaybta madaxda ah. Waayo, awoodaha habaynta guud waxay ku jiraan adiga.
welcome.quote2: Qofna kuma noolaankaro farxad haddii uu isku eego oo dhan oo uu wax kasta ku beddelo su'aal ku saabsan faa'iidadiisa keliya; waa inaad u nooshahay deriskaaga, haddii aad u noolaanayso adiga.
welcome.quote3: Wixii aan u wanaagsan shinnida, ma noqon karo mid u wanaagsan shinnida.
welcome.quote4: Waxaan u dhalannay inaan wada shaqeeyno sida cagaha, gacmaha iyo indhaha, sida labaafleydaha, sare iyo hoos. In la iska hor istaago waa dabiici ma aha.

communityWitnessing.title: Tilmaamaha Markhaatiga Bulshada
communityWitnessing.subtitle: How to safely document ICE/DHS activity as a bystander witness
communityWitnessing.homeCardDesc: Xog-ururiyo dhaqdhaqaaqa ICE si amaan ah oo aad markhaati u tahay
communityWitnessing.legalCitationText: Glik v. Cunniff (1st Cir. 2011) and Fields v. City of Philadelphia (3rd Cir. 2017) confirm the First Amendment right to record government agents performing their duties in public.
communityWitnessing.roleBody: Community witnesses serve a vital legal function. When you document an ICE encounter, you create a record that attorneys and families can use. Your calm, steady presence is a form of protection — research shows agents are more likely to follow procedure when documented by witnesses.
communityWitnessing.positioningBody: Stand far enough to observe clearly without interfering. If you can read badge numbers and see what is happening, you are close enough.
communityWitnessing.posRule1: Stay on public property — sidewalks, streets, public parks
communityWitnessing.posRule2: If asked to step back, comply — document the request
communityWitnessing.posRule3: Rule of thumb: if you can see it clearly, you are close enough
communityWitnessing.posRule4: Never block a vehicle, doorway, or agent's path
communityWitnessing.documentSubtitle: Tap to check off — capture in priority order
communityWitnessing.doc1: Agency name (ICE / CBP / Border Patrol / local police)
communityWitnessing.doc2: Badge numbers and agent names if visible
communityWitnessing.doc4: Number of agents and number of vehicles
communityWitnessing.doc6: Whether agents showed a warrant — and what type
communityWitnessing.doc7: Detained person's name and country of origin if communicated
communityWitnessing.doc8: Uniform patches and insignia (agency matters for legal routing)
communityWitnessing.pipelineBody: The most powerful thing a witness can do is capture the detained person's name. ICE can move people across facilities within hours — a name is how family and attorneys find them.
communityWitnessing.pipelineStep1: Get the detained person's name — ask if you can safely do so
communityWitnessing.pipelineStep2: Note their country of origin or citizenship if communicated
communityWitnessing.pipelineStep3: Use ICE Detainee Locator (ice.gov/detainee-locator) to find which facility they are in
communityWitnessing.pipelineStep4: Share name and facility info with their family or attorney
communityWitnessing.pipelineStep5: Use Get Legal Help to connect with immigration attorneys immediately
communityWitnessing.pipelineNote: The ICE detainee locator may not update for 12–24 hours after detention. Keep checking.
communityWitnessing.agentsBody: You are not required to speak to agents. If they approach, you have one sentence.
communityWitnessing.agentsScript: I am observing from a public space and exercising my First Amendment rights.
communityWitnessing.agentsNote: Say nothing further. Remain calm. You are not required to identify yourself in most states when you are a witness, not a suspect.
communityWitnessing.witnessPartyTitle: Witness vs. Party — Know the Difference
communityWitnessing.witnessPartyBody: Your role is documentation, not intervention. If you speak to the detained person, hand them items, or physically intervene, you risk an obstruction charge.
communityWitnessing.stoicBody: Your emotional regulation is your greatest tool. Record steadily. Keep your face neutral. Do not engage agents in debate. You serve the detained person best by staying legally clean.
communityWitnessing.stoicQuote: The impediment to action advances action. What stands in the way becomes the way.
communityWitnessing.offlineNote: All guide content works offline. No internet required.

signals.subtitle: Hababka isgaarsiinta ee isku-dubbaridka badbaadada ee dhaqdhaqaaqyada bulshada iyo kulamada.
signals.hierarchyDesc: Si looga hortago daalka dareenka, codad kala duwan u isticmaal ujeedooyin kala duwan:
signals.chantsDesc: Waxaa loo adeegsadaa dhiirigelinta, fariimaha dadweynaha, iyo luuqda.

signals.communityDesc: Isticmaal qaababkan si aad jaarka ugu wada xiriirtaan iyagoon qaylin la isticmaalin kulamada ICE.
signals.signal1Desc: Halkan fiiri. Jar baa tilmaamaya in wax feejignaan u baahan yihiin. Raadi meesha calaamadu ka timaaddo.
signals.signal1Response: Ka fiiri meel fog. U diyaargarow in aad duubto haddii loo baahdo.
signals.signal2Desc: Calaamada isku-soo-ururid. Jar baa u baahan taageero ama markhaatiyo. Tani waxay ugu yeedhaysaa bulshada in ay u soo dhowaadaan iyagoo ilaalinaya masaafo ammaan ah oo sharci ah.
signals.signal2Response: U soco calaamada si ammaan ah. Soo qaado qalabkaaga duubitaanka.
signals.signal3Title: ICE La Xaqiijiyay / Xaalad Degdeg Ah
signals.signal3Desc: Kulan firfircoon ayaa socda. Kani waa calaamad dhibaato oo muhiim ah oo tilmaamaysa khatar degdeg ah oo bulshada ku haysata.
signals.signal3Response: Hawlgeli shabakadaha taageerada sharciga. Hubi in carruurta iyo jaarka nugul la meel mariyay.
signals.signal4Desc: Khatar sare. Gudaha joog. Calaamadani waxaa la adeegsadaa marka ay weli ammaan ahayn in la joogo waddada ama marka hawlgal baaritaan socdo.
signals.signal4Response: Gudaha joog. Albaabkaaga xidh. Ha u furin qof kasta oo aan haysan amar maxkamadeed.
signals.signalOnlyDesc: Haddii aadan calaamadeynin isbeddel deegaanka ku dhacay, sanduuqda aammus ka dhig.
signals.protocol1Action: Jooji heesooyinka, eeg meesha calaamadu ka timaaddo.
signals.protocol2Action: U bannee jid; raadi dhakhtarka (Laanta Cas/Kaadhka).
signals.protocol3Action: U soco meesha bixitaanka loo qoondeeyay ama "aagga badbaadada."
signals.visualDesc: Dadka badan ee codku si wanaagsan u gaarin, isticmaal calaamadaha gacanta si aad xogta ugu gudbiso dadka kaa dambe ("Makarafoonka Aadanaha").
signals.hand2Meaning: "Ogolaansho" (waxay u ogolaataa is-af-garad aamusan oo aan hadalka laga maqlin).
signals.deescDesc: Marka tamarta ay noqoto mid argagax leh ama xoog leh oo khatar badbaado ah:
signals.dropVolumeDesc: Haddii dadweynuhu ay nixyaan sii badanayso, habraacayaashu waa in ay u beddeshaan heeso yar oo gaaban si ay u dejiyaan wadnaha kooxda.
signals.sitDownDesc: Haddii xiisada booliiska sarrayso, in safka hore la fadhiisiyo waxay muujinaysaa in la dagaal doonayo oo waxay jidh ahaan ka adkaynaysaa in "kacaan" dhaco.
signals.buddyDesc: Waligaa ha ku tiirsan sanduuqda keliya. Hubi in qof walba leeyahay "qof xiriir" oo uu la hubsado.
signals.telegramDesc: Isticmaal barnaamijyada sirta ah ee cusbooneysiinta qaban-qaabada (tusaale, "Goobta biyaha waxaa loo wareejiyay 5aad iyo Main"), laakiin xusuusnow in tiirarka telefoonka badanaa ay ku guuldareystaan dadka badan.
signals.reminder1: Ku hayso sanduuq bir ah oo tayo sare leh furayaashaada mar walba.

record.recoveryDesc: Haddii taleefankaagii la qaaday, la la wareegay, ama qalab cusub ku jirtid, waxaad u baahan tahay:
record.recoveryStep1: Faylkaaga kayd-kaab .enc — ka soo degso galkaaga Google Drive ee "SafeNeighbor Backups" ama bakadda Cloudflare R2
record.recoveryStep2: Furahaaga sirta — ka yimid iimayl-ka aad nafta u dirtay (cinwaanka: "SafeNeighbor Backup Encryption Key") ama maamulaha erayadaada sirta

record.howItWorksTitle: SIDA KAYD-KAABKA & SOO CELINTA U SHAQEEYAAN
record.step1Desc: Qabo fiidiyow ama cod adoo isticmaalaya tab-yada Fiidiyowga/Codka, kamaradaada taleefanka, ama soo dejin warbaahinta jirta. Duubitaannada waxaa la sir-geliyaa lana ku keydiyaa keydkaaga gudaha.
record.step2Desc: Fur kayd-kaabka duubitaanka si aad AES-256-GCM ugu sir-geliso oo ugu soo dirto Google Drive ama Cloudflare R2 fayl .enc ahaan. Qofna ma akhriyi karo furahaaqa la'aantiis.
record.step3Desc: Dejinta Kayd-kaabka, taabo Iimayl Furaha si aad furahaaga sirta iimayl nafta ugu dirto. Tani waa habka kaliya ee aad ku furi karto qalab kale. Si badbaado leh u kaydi.
record.step4Desc: Ka soo degso faylka .enc kayd-kaabkaaga daruuraha. Qalab kasta, fur SafeNeighbor, ku dheji furahaaga kor, oo dooro faylka si aad u furto. Duubitaanka waxaa lagu soo celinayaa keydkaaga.
record.step5Desc: Marka la soo celiyo, ka hel duubitaanka keydkaaga (leh astaanta xidh-furan). Taabo oo ku dhufo KAYDI ama SOO DEGSO si aad fiidiyowga ama codka aan sir-ahayn ugu dhoofiso qalabkaaga.

DEGDEG ka socda {{name}} ({{time}})

Waxaa laga yaabaa inaan la kulmo ciidanka ama xaalad degdeg ah. Waxaan kuu dirayaa sababtoo ah waxaa laga yaabaa inaanan si xor ah u hadli karin dhawaan.

Fadlan hadda qaado tallaabooyinkan:

1. Si degdeg ah ula xiriir qareenkaygii — ha sugin
2. Albaabka u furin qofna iyada oo aan la haysan waaran maxkamadeed la saxiixay
3. Magacayga ha u oggolaanin baaritaan ama ha uga jawaabin su'aalo
4. Haddii aan leeyahay carruur ama kuwa aan masruufkooda bixiyo, xaqiiji inay la joogaan daryeele la oggolaaday
{{planReference}}

{{location}}

trustedContacts.templateDetainedMessage:
DEGDEG ka socda {{name}} ({{time}})

Waxaa i xiray ciidanka. Waxaan isticmaalayaa xaqayga aamusnimada waxaanan waxba saxiixin. Waxaan u baahanahay inaad hadda tallaabo qaaddo.

1. Hadda la xiriir qareenkaygii — u sheeg in la i haysto goobta hoose
2. Haddii aan leeyahay carruur ama kuwa aan masruufkooda bixiyo, hubi in qof la oggolaaday uu qaado ka hor inta uusan dhammaanin maalinta dugsiga ama sida ugu dhakhsaha badan
3. Magacayga ha uga hadlin ICE, booliska, ama wakiilna
4. Magacayga ha u saxiixin waxba hana oggolaan waxba
5. Haddii aad halkaas joogto, qor magacyada iyo lambarrada baajajka saraakiisha
{{planReference}}
Ha sugin inaad wax iga maqasho — hadda bilow tallaabooyinkan.

Waxaan galayaa xaalad aan laga heli karin — mudaharaad, baaritaan, ama xaalad xasaasi ah. Tani waa taxaddar.

1. Marka hore ii soo wac ama ii soo qor
2. La xiriir qareenkaygii oo u sheeg goobta ugu dambaysay ee la ii yiqiin (hoose)
3. Hubi in qoyskaygii iyo kuwa aan masruufkooda bixiyo ay nabdoon yihiin
4. Haddii 4 saacadood ka dib aan wali jawaab la helin, la xiriir caawinta sharciga ee deegaanka ama khadka hoose
{{planReference}}

legal.aiDisclaimerText: AI-gan wuxuu bixiyaa macluumaad guud oo ku saabsan xuquuqda dastuuriga ah — ma aha talo sharci. Talo sharci oo gaar ah, la tasho qareen shati leh.
legal.aiEmptyPrompt: Su'aal ka weydii xuquuqdaada dastuuriga ah
legal.aiSuggestion1: Maxay tahay farqiga u dhexeeya waaran maxkamadeed iyo mid maamul?
legal.aiSuggestion2: Miyaan ku waajibaa inaan ka jawaabo su'aalaha ICE?

legal.aiError: Waan ka xumahay, khalad ayaa dhacay. Fadlan mar kale isku day.
legal.rateLimitMinute: Codsiyo badan oo isku mar ah. Fadlan daqiiqad sug intaadan su'aal kale weyddiinin.
legal.rateLimitHour: Xadka saacaddii waa la gaaray (30 su'aalood/saacaddii). Fadlan mar kale isku day.
legal.constitutionalRightsSubtitle: Guji wax ka beddelid si aad u sahashid ilaalinta faahfaahsan iyo kiisaska maxkamadda.
legal.amendment1stQuote: "Kongresku waa inuusan sameynin sharci... xaddidaya xorriyadda hadalka, ama warbaahinta; ama xaqa dadweynaha inay si nabad ah isugu yimaadaan, iyo inay dowladda ka dalbanaan daawooyinka cabashooyinkooda."
legal.recordingYouCanRecord: Waa Duubi Kartaa: Waxaad xaq u leedahay inaad duubto booliska iyo ICE goobaha dadweynaha ee aad si sharci ah joogto.
legal.recordingStayAtDistance: Fog Joog: Ka duub meel fog oo badbaado leh (8-10 fiidh). Ha faragelin saraakiisha jir ahaan.
legal.recordingDocumentEverything: Wax Walba Diiwaan Geli: Duub lambarka baadhiga, lambarka gaadiidka, wakhtiga, goobta, iyo tirada saraakiisha.
legal.protestPeacefulAssembly: Isu-imaad Nabad ah: Waxaad xaq u leedahay inaad si nabad ah isugu timaadid goobaha dadweynaha sida jidadka lugta, beerta, iyo barxadaha.
legal.protestPermits: Oggolaanshaha: Oggolaansho ayaa loo baahan yahay isu-imaadyada waaweyn laakiin lama diidi karo iyada oo ku saleysan qoraalka fariinta. Mudaaharaadyada kedis ah ee ka jawaabaya dhacdooyinka waxay caadi ahaan u helan ilaalin.
legal.protestCounterProtests: Mudaaharaadyada Lidka ah: Mudaaharaad-lidyeedku waxay leeyihiin xuquuq la mid ah. Booliska waa inay kooxaha kala soocaan laakiin uma oggola inay taageeraan dhinac fariintiisa.
legal.protestDispersalOrders: Amarrada Kala-firdhinta: Haddii booliska ay bixiyaan amar sharci ah oo kala-firdhin, waa inaad tagto ama aad khatar ugu jirtaa in lagugu xiro. Diiwaan geli amarkaas haddii suurtagal tahay.
legal.speechProtected: Hadalka la Ilaaliyay: Waxaad dhaliil ka dhigan kartaa dowladda, booliska, iyo siyaasadda muhaajiriinta. Hadalka siyaasadeed ayaa hela ilaalinta ugu sarreysa.
legal.speechSignsSymbols: Calaamadaha & Astaamaha: Waxaad qaadi kartaa calaamado, waxaad xidhan kartaa dhar fariimo leh, waxaadna muujin kartaa astaamaha. Xaddidaadda ku salaysan waxa qoran waxay u badan tahay inay dastuur ka hor yihiin.
legal.speechNotProtected: Lama Ilaaliyaan: Hanjabaabyada dhabta ah, ku dhiirrigelinta fal sharci-darro ah oo dhaqso ah, iyo "erayada dagaalka" lama ilaaliyaan. Ka fogow af aad loo fasiri karo hanjabaabyada.
legal.pressJournalistProtections: Ilaalinta Wariyayaasha: Wariyayaashu waxay leeyihiin xaq gelid oo la mid ah dadweynaha laakiin ma helaan gelid gaar ah oo ka badan taas. Aqoonsiga saxaafaddu ma siinayo xuquuq dheeraad ah laakiin wuxuu kaa caawin karaa in laguu garto.
legal.pressAnyoneCanDocument: Qof Kasta Wuu Diiwaan Gelin Karaa: Xiligan casriga ah, maxkamadahu waxay aqoonsadeen in qof kasta oo telefoon haysta uu matali karo saxaafad muwaadin. Uma baahnid aqoonsi si aad u diiwaan geliso dhacdooyinka warbaahinta xiga.
legal.linkDojMisconduct: DOJ: Wax Ka Qabashada Xadgudubka Booliska →
legal.amendment4thQuote: "Xaqa dadweynaha inay ka badbaadaan qofkooda, guryahooda, waraaqahooda, iyo hantidooda, baaritaano iyo qabashooyin aan macquul ahayn, waa inaan la xadgudbin..."
legal.fourthYourHome: Gurigaaga: ICE waxay u baahan yihiin waaran maxkamadeed oo ay saxiixday xaakim si ay ugu galaan gurigaaga ama goobaha shaqada ee gaarka ah.
legal.fourthAdminVsJudicial: Maamul vs Maxkamadeed: Waaran maamul (uu saxiixay ICE) MA siinayso awood ay ku galaan gurigaaga.
legal.fourthConsent: Oggolaansho: Weligaa ha oggolaan baaritaano. Si cad u sheeg: "Kuma ogola baaritaan kasta."
legal.amendment5thQuote: "Qof kasta... lagama khasbi karo inuu kiis dambiyeed ku markhaati furo naftiisa..."
legal.fifthCanStaySilent: Waxaad Aamusan Kari Kartaa: Kuma waajibna inaad ka jawaabto su'aalaha ICE ama booliska.
legal.fifthHowToAssert: Sida Loo Sheego: Dheh: "Waxaan isticmaalayaa xaqayga aamusnaanta."
legal.fifthRequestLawyer: Codso Qareen: Dheh: "Waxaan rabaa inaan la hadlo qareen."
legal.amendment6thQuote: "Dacwooyinka dambiilaha oo dhan, kan lagu eedaynayo wuxuu xaq u leeyahay... inuu helo Caawinta Qareen difaaciisa."
legal.sixthRightToLawyer: Xaqa Qareen: Waxaad xaq u leedahay qareen inta lagu jiro dacwad dambiyeed kasta, oo ay ku jiraan eedeymo dambiyeed oo la xiriira muhaajiriinta.
legal.sixthHowToAssert: Sida Loo Sheego: Dheh: "Waxaan rabaa inaan la hadlo qareen intaanan ka jawaabin su'aal kasta."
legal.sixthPublicDefender: Qareen Dadweyne: Haddaad awoodi weydid qareen, mid ayaa laguu magacaabi karaa eedeymo dambiyeed (ma aha dacwooyinka muhaajiriinta ee madaniga ah).
legal.sixthImmigrationCourt: Maxkamadda Muhaajiriinta: Ma jiro damaanad qareen bilaash ah oo ku jira maxkamadda muhaajiriinta — raadi caawimo sharci bilaash ah haddii loo baahdo.
legal.amendment14thQuote: "...gobolna kama saari karo qof kasta nolosha, xorriyadda, ama hantida, iyada oo aan la raacin nidaam sharci; kumana diidi karo qof kasta oo xukunkeeda ku jira ilaalinta sinnaanta sharciga."
legal.whyThisMattersImmigration: Sababta Tani Muhiimka u Tahay Muhaajiriinta:
legal.fourteenthAppliesToEveryone: Waxay Ku Shaqeysaa Qof Kasta: Dastuurku wuxuu leeyahay "qof kasta" — ma aha muwaadiniinta kaliya. Xuquuqdani waxay khusaysaa dhammaan dadka jooga dhulka Mareykanka iyadoon loo eegin xaaladda muhaajiriinta.
legal.fourteenthDueProcess: Nidaamka Sharci: Laguma xiri karo ama laguma celin karo iyada oo aan la raacin dacwadaha sharciga ee ku habboon. Dowladda waa inay raacdo nidaamyada la dejiyay.
legal.fourteenthEqualProtection: Ilaalinta Sinnaanta: Dowladdu kugu sooci kari weydo adiga oo keliya ku salaysan jinsiyadda, asalka, ama wadanka aad ka timid.
legal.fourteenthCourtAccess: Gelitaanka Maxkamadda: Waxaad xaq u leedahay inaad ka muuqato xaakim muhaajiriinta iyo inaad soo bandhigto kiiskaaga, oo ay ku jirto codsiyada magangalyada.
legal.civilDisobedienceSubtitle: Fahamka ilaalintaada dastuuriga ah inta lagu jiro falalka caasinta madaniga ee nabadeed.
legal.civilDisobedienceDisclaimer: Qaybtan waxay bixisaa macluumaad sharci guud oo ku saabsan xuquuqdaada dastuuriga ah inta lagu jiro caasinta madaniga. Ma aha talo sharci mana aha dhiirrigelinta jabitnin sharci kasta. Caasinta madaniga qeexitaankeeda ayaa ka mid ah aqbalida cawaaqibta sharciga ee falaadkaaga. Had iyo jeer la tasho qareen inta ka hor, inta lagu jiro, iyo ka dib xaalad sharci kasta.
legal.cdRightToAssemble: Xaqa Isu-imaadka: 1st Amendment waxay ilaaliyaan xaqa dadka inay si nabad ah isugu yimaadaan. Tani waxaa ka mid ah socodaalada, fadhiyada, feejignaanaha, shirarka, iyo noocyada kale ee muujinta wadajirka ee hantida dadweynaha.
legal.cdRightToPetition: Xaqa Dalbanida: Waxaad xaq dastuuri ah u leedahay inaad dowladda ka dalbanayso daawooyinka cabashooyinkaaga. Tani waxaa ka mid ah mudaaharaadyo, bannaanbaxyo, iyo falalka isu-habeynta caasinta nabadeed.
legal.cdFreedomOfSpeech: Xorriyadda Hadalka: Mudaaharaadka nabadeed waa nooc hadalka la ilaaliyay. Calaamadaha, heesaha, waraaqaha, iyo muujinta calaamadeed (sida gacmo-haadyada ama feejignaanaha aamusta ah) oo dhan waa hawlo dastuuriga ah oo la ilaaliyay.
legal.caseNaacp: NAACP v. Claiborne Hardware (1982): Maxkamadda Sare waxay go'aamiyay in qeybaha nabadeed ee mudaaharaad (qaadashada, socodaalada, khudbadaha) ay yihiin kuwo dastuuriga ah oo la ilaaliyay xitaa haddii qaar ka mid ah ka qaybgalayaasha ay ku lug leeyihiin rabsho. Ka qaybgalayaasha nabadeed lagama masuuli karo falalka dadka kale.
legal.caseEdwards: Edwards v. South Carolina (1963): Maxkamaddu waxay buriyay xukunnadii 187 arday oo Madow ah oo loo xiray mudaaharaad nabadeed oo ka dhanka ah kala-soocista xarunta gobolka. Mudaaharaadka nabadeed ee dhulka dadweynaha waxaa ilaalinaya 1st iyo 14th Amendments.
legal.caseTinker: Tinker v. Des Moines (1969): Maxkamaddu waxay go'aamiyay in xirashada gacmo-haadyada madow ee looga soo horjeedayo dagaalka Vietnam ay tahay hadal calaamadeed oo la ilaaliyay. "Ardaydu xaq dastuurigoodii kama tuuraan albaabka dugsiga."
legal.caseCox: Cox v. Louisiana (1965): Maxkamaddu waxay go'aamiyay in gargaadka iyo socodaalka nabadeed ay yihiin noocyo muujin oo la ilaaliyay. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, dowladdu waxay soo rogi kartaa xaddidaadyo macquul ah oo ku saabsan wakhtiga, goobta, iyo habka.
legal.protectedVsUnprotected: Hawlaha la Ilaaliyay vs Kuwa aan la Ilaaliyayn
legal.cdGenerallyProtected: Guud ahaan waa la Ilaaliyay: Socodaalka jidadka lugta iyo goobaha dadweynaha, hayashada calaamadaha, heesaha, qaybinta waraaqaha, feejignaanaha aamusta ah, qaadashada, silsilado bini-aadmi oo goobaha dadweynaha ah, hadalka calaamadeed (gacmo-haadyada, calanka).
legal.cdMayCrossLines: Laga Yaabaa Inay Xad-gudub Sharci Noqoto: Xirida jidadka ama iridaha, haysashada hantida gaarka ah, diidmada inuu tago ka dib amar sharci ah, faragelinta hawlaha dowladda. Falalkan waxay keeni karaan in la xiro — ogaaw cawaaqibta suurtagalka ah intaadan ka qaybgelin.
legal.movementCivilRights: Dhaqdhaqaaqa Xuquuqda Madaniga (1950-60-yadii): Fadhiyada miisaska qadada, Safarrada Xorriyadda, Qaadashada Baska ee Montgomery, iyo Socodaalka Washington waxay isticmaaleen caasinta madaniga ee nabadeed si ay uga soo horjeedaan kala-soocista iyo inay sugaan Sharciga Xuquuqda Madaniga ee 1964 iyo Sharciga Xuquuqda Codaynta ee 1965.
legal.movementSuffrage: Xuquuqda Codaynta Haweenka (1848-1920): Dagaallamayaashii xuquuqda haweenka waxay abaabuleen socodaallo, gargaad agagaarka Aqalka Cad, iyo cunno-joojin. Kuwa badan ayaa la xiray oo la xabsiyay ka hor inta aan la ansixin 19th Amendment.
legal.movementLabor: Dhaqdhaqaaqa Shaqaalaha (1880-1940-yadii): Shaqo joojin, fadhi-diid, iyo gargaadyo waxay u dagaallameen 8 saacadood oo shaqo ah maalintii, badbaadada goobta shaqada, iyo xaqa isu-habeynta. Falalkan waxay horseedeen Sharciga Xiriirka Shaqaalaha Qaranka iyo Sharciga Heerarka Shaqada ee Cadaaladda.
legal.movementSanctuary: Dhaqdhaqaaqa Magan-gelinta (1980-yadii ilaa hadda): Kiniisado iyo bulshooyinku waxay bixiyeen magan-gelin qoxooti iyo muhaajiriin aan dukumiinti lahayn, iyagoo ku tiirsanaya dhaqamada diiniga iyo anshaxa ee bixinta gabbaadka kuwa dhibaatooyinka la kulma.
legal.arrestRightToSilence: Xaqa Aamusnaanta: Si cad u dheh: "Waxaan isticmaalayaa xaqayga aamusnaanta." Kuma waajibna inaad ka jawaabto su'aal kasta. Wax kasta oo aad dhahdid waa laga isticmaali karaa. Aamusnaantu laguma isticmaali karo caddayn eed ah.
legal.arrestRightToAttorney: Xaqa Qareen: Si cad u dheh: "Waxaan rabaa inaan la hadlo qareen." Markaad codsatid xaqan, booliska waa inay joojiyaan waydiinteeda. Haddaad awoodi weydid qareen, mid ayaa laguu magacaabi doonaa. Ha ka jawaabin su'aalo ilaa qareenkaaga joogo.
legal.arrestRightToKnowCharges: Xaqa Ogaanshaha Eedaynta: Waxaad xaq u leedahay in laguugu sheego waxa lagugu eedaynayo. Weydii: "Maxaa la igu eedaynayaa?" Waxaad xaq u leedahay maxkamadeyn degdeg ah (caadi ahaan 48-72 saacadood gudahooda).
legal.bookingProcess: Nidaamka: Faraha ayaa lagaa qaadayaa, sawir ayaa lagaa qaadayaa, hantidaada gaarkana waa la tiriyaa. Caadi ahaan waxaa laguu oggolaanayaa ugu yaraan hal wicitaan. Waa lagugu hayn karaa ilaa maxkamadaynta ama ilaa dammaanadda la bixiyo.
legal.bookingBail: Dammaanad: Xaakim ayaa dejiya dammaanadda iyada oo ku saleysan eedaynta, khatarta cararaadka, iyo xiriirka bulshada. Doorashooyinku waxaa ka mid ah: Dammaanad lacag ah (bixinta lacagta oo dhan, dib laguu soo celinayaa kiiska ka dib), dammaanad rabitaan (bixinta 10% qof dammaanad-dhigaha, aan la soo celin), ama sii-dayn OR ah (laguu sii daayo amaankaaga, lacag la'aan — waxay caadi u tahay eedaymo yaryar oo la xiriira mudaaharaadka).
legal.doNotExplain: Ha iskaba sharin: Ha isku dayin inaad caddayso falaadkaaga, aad sheekooyinkaada u sheegtid, ama aad "arrimaha u caddaysid" booliska. U kaydi qareenkaaga.
legal.doNotConsentSearches: Ha oggolaan baaritaano: Dheh: "Kuma ogola baaritaan." Way ku baari karaan iyaga oo ku xiray, laakiin diidmadaada afka ah waxay ilaaliyaan xuquuqdaada maxkamadda.
legal.doNotResist: Ha iska celin jir ahaan: Xitaa haddaad rumaysan tahay xiritaanku waa sharci-darro, ha iska celin jir ahaan. Iska celinta waxay ku dari kartaa eedaymo dheeraad ah. Degganaaw, jir ahaan yeelmid, laakiin afkaaga ku sheeg xuquuqdaada.

legal.chargeTrespassing: Xad-gudubka Hanti: Gelitaanka ama joogitaanka hanti iyada oo oggolaansho la'aan. Waxay caadi u tahay fadhiyada ama haysashada dhismayaasha. Caadi ahaan waa dambi yar. Ciqaabtu waxay ku kala duwan tahay gobolka laakiin waxay badanaa ka kooban tahay ganaax $100-$1,000 iyo ilaa 30 maalmood oo xabsi. Difaac: waxaad ku doodda kartaa hantidii waxay u furnaa dadweynaha ama aad isticmaalaysay xuquuqda 1st Amendment ee hantida dadweynaha.
legal.chargeDisorderlyConduct: Dabeecad Khaldan: Eedayn ballaaran oo badanaa loo isticmaalo mudaaharaadyada. Caadi ahaan waxay daboolaysaa "carqaladaynta nabadda," "qaylo aan macquul ahayn," ama "dabeecad rabshada ah." Tani waa eedaynta ugu caadisan ee xiritaanka mudaaharaadyada. Caadi ahaan waa dambi yar oo ganaax iyo xabsi gaaban leh. Eedaymahani badanaa waa la ridaa ama la tirtiraa.
legal.chargeUnlawfulAssembly: Isu-imaad Sharci-darro ah: Marka maamulku ku dhawaaqo isu-imaad inuu yahay sharci-darro — caadi ahaan markay go'aamiyaan inay keenayso "khatar cad oo joogta ah" oo rabsho ama burburinta hanti. Amar kala-firdhin rasmi ah waa in la bixiyaa ka hor eedayntan inta aanay khusaynin. Waa in la siiyaa fursad macquul ah oo ay ku tagaan.
legal.chargeFailureToDisperse: Diidmada Kala-firdhinta: Joogitaanka ka dib markii amar sharci ah oo kala-firdhin la bixiyay. Amarku waa inuu maqal yahay oo cad yahay. Waa in la siiyaa wakhti macquul ah si loo tago. Haddii jidadka bixitaanka ay xiraan booliska, tani waxay noqon kartaa difaac. Diiwaan geli wakhtiga amarku la bixiyay iyo haddii jid cad oo aad ku tagto uu jiro.
legal.chargeObstruction: Caqabad-gelinta / Iska Celinta Xiritaanka: Faragelinta jir ahaaneed ee sarkaalka ama iska celinta xiritaan sharci ah. Kaliya dhib-sanaanshaha (iska celinta jilicsan) laga yaabo inay ama aynay noqon iska celin iyada oo ku xiran sharciga gobolka. Cabashooyinka afka ah ee booliska waxay guud ahaan yihiin hadal la ilaaliyay. Iska celinta jirka ah had iyo jeer waxay ku dartaa eedaymo — degganaaw oo jir ahaan yeelmid adiga oo afkaaga ku sheegaya xuquuqdaada.
legal.chargeFederalVsState: Eedaymo Federaal ah vs Goboleed: Inta badan xiritaanada mudaaharaadyada waa eedaymo gobol ama degmo. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, eedaymo federaal ah waxay khusayn karaan hantida federaalka (maxkamadaha, dhismayaasha federaalka, beerta qaranka), marka la gudbo xadka gobolka si loo kiciyay rabsho (Sharciga Rabshada Lidka), ama marka mudaaharaadyada bartilmaameedkoodu yahay hawlaha federaalka. Eedaymaha federaalka ciqaabtooda way ka daran tahay waxaana lagu dacweeyaa maxkamadda federaalka.

legal.safetyBuddySystem: Nidaamka Saaxiibtinimo: Weligaa keligaa ha tegin. La laab qof aad ku kalsoon tahay. Ku heshii goobtii la kulanka haddii la kala tago. Qorshahaaga la wadaag qof AAN ka qaybgaleynin.
legal.safetyLegalSupport: Xiriirka Taageerada Sharciga: Lambarka taleefanka qareenka ku qor cudkaaga khad joogto ah (taleefanaha waa la qaadi karaa). Khadka National Lawyers Guild: (212) 679-5100. U magacaw qof "taageero xabsi" oo bixin kara dammaanad una xiriiri kara qareenada.
legal.safetyWhatToBring: Waxa La Qaadanayo: Aqoonsi dowladeed, daawooyin lagama maarmaan ah (weelahooda asalka ah), biyo, cunto fudud, lacag caddaan ah oo dammaanad ama gaadiid, taleefan buuxda oo leh xiriirka degdega.
legal.safetyWhatNotToBring: Waxa AADAN Qaadan: Hub nooc kasta ah, daroogo ama khamro, waxyaabo qiimo leh ama dahab, qalab elektiroonig aan lagama maarmaan ahayn, wax kasta oo aadan rabin in laga qaado, muraayadaha xiriirka (gaaska ilmada — muraayadaha caadiga ah keen).
legal.safetyKnowLocalLaws: Ogaaw Sharciyada Deegaanka: Baaritaan ku samee shuruudaha oggolaanshaha, sharciyada habeen-cagta deegaanka, iyo qawaaniinta gaarka ah. Ogaaw meelaha hantida dadweynaha vs gaarka ah. Faham sharciyada gobolkaaga ee gaarka ah ee ku saabsan isu-imaadka sharci-darrrada iyo diidmada kala-firdhinta.
legal.safetyDeescalation: Dejinta Xaaladda: Degganaaw oo aan hanjabaabayn. Gacmahaaga muuji. Ku hadal cod deggan, oo joogta ah. Ha samaynin dhaqdhaqaaq kedis ah. Yeelmid amarrada sharciga ah adiga oo afkaaga ku sheegaya xuquuqdaada.
legal.safetyDocumentEverything: Wax Walba Diiwaan Geli: Duub fiidiyow marka ay badbaado tahay (tani waa xaqaaga 1st Amendment). Qor lambarada baadhiga, magacyada hay'adda, lambarada gaadiidka, iyo wakhtiyadda. Haddii aad aragto xadgudub, ka qaad macluumaadka xiriirka markhaatiyada kale.
legal.safetyMedicalAwareness: Ka War-qaadka Caafimaadka: Ogaaw halka tababbaryahanka caafimaadka jidadka ay joogaan (eeg calaamadda cas ee iskutallaallada). Haddii aad qaadato daawo dhakhtarku qoray, iska qaado. Haddii gaaska ilmada la adeegsado: dhanka dabaysha u socoday gal, indhahaaga ha masaxin, biyo ama xalka cusbo ku dhaqi.
legal.safetyDocumentWhileFresh: Diiwaan Geli Iyadoo Cusub: Qor wax kasta oo aad xasuusato sida ugu dhakhsaha badan: yaa joogay, maxaa dhacay, goorma iyo xaggee dhacdooyinku ay ka dhaceen, lambarada baadhiga, magacyada markhaatiyada, iyo isticmaalka xoog kasta. Faahfaahintu way sii lumaysaa.
legal.safetyFindingLegalSupport: Helitaanka Taageerada Sharciga: La xiriir National Lawyers Guild (NLG) (212) 679-5100 si aad u hesho tixraacyo. Ururrada gargaarka sharciga ee deegaanku waxay badanaa leeyihiin ilo gaar ah oo ku saabsan mudaaharaadyada. Haddii lagugu xiro, waxaad u qalantaa qareen dadweyne haddaad awoodi weydid qareen gaar ah.
legal.safetyFilingComplaints: Gudbinta Cabashooyinka: Haddii aad la kulantay xadgudubka booliska, cabashada ka gudbi qaybta arrimaha gudaha ee waaxda, guddiga cabashooyinka rayidka ee deegaankaaga, iyo ACLU. Ka sawir dhaawacyada kasta. Kaydi koobi dhammaan dukumentiyada.

legal.mlkAttribution: — Martin Luther King Jr., Warqaddii Xabsiga Birmingham (1963)
legal.philosophyStoicDuty: Waajibka Stoic ee Bulshada: Falsafadda Stoic waxay bareen in aan marka hore nahay muwaadiniinta dunida, iyo in cadaaladdu way u baahan tahay ficil — ma aha oo keliya daawasho. Marcus Aurelius wuxuu qoray: "Waxa aan u wanaagsanayn shinida, uma wanaagsanaan karo shinida." Epictetus wuxuu baray in awooda habeynta dhammaantiis ay ku jirto qof kasta. Marka sharciyadu waxyeelayaan bulshada, falsafadda Stoic waxay qabataa in damiirka iyo waajibka dadka kale ay u baahan karaan ficil mabda' ku salaysan.
legal.philosophyThoreau: Henry David Thoreau — "Caasinta Madaniga" (1849): Thoreau wuxuu ku dooday in shakhsiyaadku ay waajib ka saaran yihiin inay damiirkooda raacaan halkii ay raaci lahaayeen sharciyada aan cadaaladda ahayn. Xabsiga ayuu galay halkii uu canshuur ku taageeri lahaa addoonsiga iyo Dagaalkii Meksiko-Mareykan. Maqaalkiisu wuxuu noqday qoraalka aasaaska ah ee iska celinta nabadeed, oo si toos ah u saameeya Gandhi iyo King.
legal.philosophyKing: Martin Luther King Jr. — Warqaddii Xabsiga Birmingham (1963): King wuxuu kala saaray sharciyada cadaaladda ah iyo kuwa aan cadaaladda ahayn: "Sharci cadaalad ah waa xeer aadanaha sameeyay oo waafaqsan sharciga anshaxa. Sharci aan cadaaladda ahayn waa xeer ka baxsan sharciga anshaxa." Wuxuu ku dooday in ficilka tooska ah ee nabadeed uu abuuro xiisadda lagama maarmaan u ah isbeddelka, iyo in kuwa jabiya sharciyada aan cadaaladda ahayn ay samayn karaan "si furan, jacayl, iyo diyaarnimo lagu aqbalo ciqaabta."
legal.philosophyGandhi: Mahatma Gandhi — Satyagraha: Falsafadda Gandhi ee "xoogga runtaa" ama "xoogga ruuxda" waxay qabataa in iska celinta nabadeed ay tahay hubka ugu xooggan ee ka dhanka ah dulmi. Mabaadiiciisa: weligaa ha waxyeelin cadowgaaga, aqbal dhibaatada iyada oo aan la aargoosan, had iyo jeer run ahaw, oo aqoonso aadaminimada cadowgaaga. Socodaalkii Cusbo ee 1930 wuxuu muujiyay sida caasinta madaniga ee balaaran ay u beddeli karto wacyiga dadweynaha.
legal.philosophyCommonThread: Xarigga Wadaaga: Laga bilaabo falsafadda Stoic ilaa Thoreau ilaa King ilaa Gandhi, dhaqanka caasinta madaniga wuxuu ku salaysan yahay qirasho wadaag ah: in shakhsiyaadku ay leeyihiin waajib akhlaaqeed inay wax ka qabtaan marka sharciyadu ama nidaamyadu waxyeelayaan dadka kale, iyo in ficilka nabadeed — oo si furan loo qaado iyadoo la aqbalayo cawaaqibta — uu yahay xoogga ugu weyn ee cadaaladda.

scenarioData.familyKitDesc: Qorshe tallaabo-tallaabo ah oo loogu talagalay qoyskaaga haddii wax dhacaan.
scenarioData.familyKitStep1Action: MAGACAAB QOFKA AAD KU KALSOON TAHAY
scenarioData.familyKitStep1Script: Dooro 1-3 qof oo aad ku kalsoon tahay: qareen, xubin qoys, ama qabanqaabiye bulsheed. U sheeg qorshahaga.
scenarioData.familyKitStep1Explanation: Kuwani waa dadka ku matalaya haddii lagaa xiro ama aadan la soo xiriiri karin. Waxay u baahan yihiin inay qorshaha ogaadaan HADDA, kaddib maaha.
scenarioData.familyKitStep2Script: Magacaab qof maamula arrimaha maaliyadda, daryeelka carruurta, iyo go'aamada hantida haddii aadan wax ka qabankarayn.
scenarioData.familyKitStep2Explanation: Power of Attorney (POA) waxay u oggolaataa qof aad ku kalsoon tahay inuu go'aamada sharciga ah ee kuu sameeyo. La'aantiis, maxkamadda ayaa go'aanisa — taasina waqti ayay qaadataa oo qoyskaagu uusan haysan karin.
scenarioData.familyKitStep3Script: Soo ururi: aqoonsiyada dawladda, shahaadooyinka dhalashada, dukumeentiyada socdaalka, diiwaannada caafimaadka, kaarka caymiska. Kaydi nuqullada qofka aad ku kalsoon tahay.
scenarioData.familyKitStep3Explanation: Haddii lagaa xiro, qoyskaagu waxay u baahan doonaan dukumentiyadaan. Kaydi asalka meel ammaan ah iyo nuqullada qof aad ku kalsoon tahay.
scenarioData.familyKitStep4Script: Magacaab 2+ qof oo la fasaxo inay carruurta dugsiga ka soo qaadaan. Ogeysii xafiiska dugsiga qoraal ahaan.
scenarioData.familyKitStep4Explanation: Haddii aanad awoodin inaad carruurta soo qaaddo, dugsiga wuxuu u baahan yahay fasax qoraal ah oo hore si carruurta ugu sii daayo qof kale.
scenarioData.familyKitStep5Script: Buuxi: charger-ka taleefanka, lacagta caddaan ah, dawada loo baahan yahay, nuqullada dukumentiyadda, kaarka qareenka, dhar beddelasho.
scenarioData.familyKitStep5Explanation: Haddii lagaa xiro, in aad diyaar u leedahay alaabta aasaasiga ah waxay badbaadisaa waqti muhiim ah. Kaydi boorsada meel qofka aad ku kalsoon tahay uu heli karo.
scenarioData.familyKitStep6Script: Xasuuso: lambarka qareenkaaga, lambarka xubin qoys, National Immigration Detention Hotline (1-833-560-0927).
scenarioData.familyKitStep6Explanation: Waxaa laga yaabaa inaadan heli doonto taleefankaaga. Xasuusashada lambarrrada muhiimka ah waxay hubinaysaa inaad wicitaanno ka samayn karto xabsiga.
scenarioData.familyKitStep7Script: Kala hadal qorshaha si deggan qoyskaaga. Ku celceli: "Haddii aanan guriga imaanayn, wac [magaca qofka aad ku kalsoon tahay]."
scenarioData.familyKitStep7Explanation: Carruurta iyo xubnaha qoysku waxay u baahan yihiin inay ogaadaan waxa ay sameeyaan iyagoo aan argagixin. Ku celceli qorshaha si qof walba u dareemo diyaar ah, aan baqdin.
scenarioData.familyKitOverview: Diyaargarowgu waa waxa ugu awooda badan oo aad samayn karto ka hor inta aysan wax dhicin. Dadka badan ee la xiro waxay ku leh isla wax: "Waxaan jeclaan lahaa inaan qoyskaygii u sheegay waxa ay sameeyaan." Liiskan wuxuu hubinayaa in qoyskaagu qorshe leeyahay, dukumentiyadaadu ay helidooda fudud tahay, iyo in dadka aad ku kalsoon tahay ay doorkooda yaqaanaan.
scenarioData.familyKitKeyPoint1: ✓ Magacaab 1-3 qof oo aad ku kalsoon tahay (qareen, qoys, qabanqaabiye)
scenarioData.familyKitKeyPoint2: ✓ Samee Power of Attorney oo loogu talagalay maaliyadda iyo daryeelka carruurta
scenarioData.familyKitKeyPoint3: ✓ Soo ururi oo nuqullee dhammaan dukumentiyadda muhiimka ah
scenarioData.familyKitKeyPoint4: ✓ Samee qoraal fasaxeed oo dugsiga lagu soo qaado carruurta
scenarioData.familyKitKeyPoint5: ✓ Diyaari boorso socod oo leh alaabta aasaasiga ah
scenarioData.familyKitKeyPoint6: ✓ Xasuuso lambarka qareenkaaga iyo khadka xabsiga
scenarioData.familyKitKeyPoint7: ✓ Kala hadal qoyskaaga si deggan — ku celceli qorshaha wada jir
scenarioData.familyKitWarrantJudicialDesc: Dukumeentiyada, dadka la xiriiri karo, qorshe dugsiga, boorso socod, lambarrrada la xasuusto, wadahadal qoyska.
scenarioData.familyKitWarrantAdminDesc: Qorshe la'aan carruurta, dukumeentiyada kala firidhsan, qareen la dooran, qoyska aan ogayn.
scenarioData.doorDesc: Tallaabooyinka ay ku hadli karto albaabka iyagoo aan furin.
scenarioData.doorStep1Explanation: Weligaa ha furin albaabka. Kaga hadal dhexdiisa.
scenarioData.doorStep2Script: Fadlan aqoonsigaaga albaabka hoostiisa geli ama daaqadda kor u hay.
scenarioData.doorStep2Explanation: Xaq ayaad u leedahay inaad xaqiijiso ciddooda.
scenarioData.doorStep3Script: Ma haysataa amar gelitaan oo garsooraha saxiixay? Fadlan albaabka hoostiisa geli.
scenarioData.doorStep3Explanation: ICE waxay u baahan yihiin amar garsooraha (oo garsooraha saxiixay) si ay guriga u galaan. Amar maamuleed (administrative warrant) kuma filna.
scenarioData.doorStep4Script: Kama oggoli inaad gurigayga gashaan. Waxaan isticmaalayaa xaqa aamusnaan waxaanan doonayaa inaan qareen la hadlo.
scenarioData.doorStep5Script: Bilow duubista codka/fiidiyowga daaqadda hadii ay ammaan tahay.
scenarioData.doorStep5Explanation: Xaq ayaad u leedahay inaad duubto saraakiisha sharciga ah ee albaabkaaga jooga.
scenarioData.doorOverview: ICE ma geli karto gurigaaga iyadoon leydin amar gelitaan oo garsooraha saxiixay. Xuquuqda dastuurka ah ayaa ku ilaaliya.
scenarioData.doorKeyPoint2: ✓ Weydiiso inaad aragto amarka gelitaanka albaabka/daaqadda dhexdooda
scenarioData.doorKeyPoint3: ✓ Hubi in amarka uu garsooraha saxiixay (judicial) mise saraakiil ICE (administrative)
scenarioData.doorKeyPoint4: ✓ Amarka maamuleed (Administrative warrant) kuma siinayo ICE fasax ay gurigaaga galaan
scenarioData.doorKeyPoint5: ✓ Xaq ayaad u leedahay inaad aamustid
scenarioData.doorKeyPoint6: ✓ Waxaad diidi kartaa inaad su'aalaha ka jawaabtid
scenarioData.doorWarrantJudicialDesc: Waxay u oggolaataa ICE inay gurigaaga galaan
scenarioData.streetDesc: Ma xor tahay inaad tagto? Sida loo isticmaalo aamusnaan meelaha dadweynaha.
scenarioData.streetStep1Action: WEYDIISO HADII AAD XOR U TAHAY INAAD TAGTO
scenarioData.streetStep1Script: Miyaan xor u ahay inaan aado?
scenarioData.streetStep1Explanation: Tani waa su'aasha ugu muhiimsan. Haddii ay yiraahdaan haa, si deggan u soco.
scenarioData.streetStep2Script: Waxaan isticmaalayaa xaqa aamusnaan. Dooni maayo inaan su'aalaha ka jawaabo.
scenarioData.streetStep2Explanation: Waxaad leedahay xaqa Taddiilka 5aad ee aamusnaan.
scenarioData.streetStep3Explanation: Taddiilka 4aad wuxuu dhawraa baaritaan aan macquul ahayn.
scenarioData.streetStep4Script: Waxaan doonayaa inaan qareen la hadlo.
scenarioData.streetStep4Explanation: Xaq ayaad u leedahay matallaad sharci.
scenarioData.streetStep5Script: Gacmahaaga muuji. Ha ordin. Xasilli deggan oo si sharaf leh ula dhaqan.
scenarioData.streetStep5Explanation: Hoos u dhigista xaaladu waa furaha badbaadintaada.
scenarioData.streetOverview: Meelaha dadweynaha, ICE ayaa kuu soo dhowaan karta. Waxaad leedahay xaqa aamusnaan iyo xaqa ah inaad weydiiso hadii aad xor u tahay inaad tagto. Ha ordin, been sheegid, ama dukumeentiyada been ah muujin.

scenarioData.streetKeyPoint2: ✓ Xaq ayaad u leedahay inaad aamustid
scenarioData.streetKeyPoint3: ✓ Uma baahnid inaad ka jawaabtid su'aalaha ku saabsan xaaladdaada socdaalka
scenarioData.streetKeyPoint4: ✓ Ha ordin ama jirka ha iska caabin
scenarioData.streetKeyPoint5: ✓ Ha been sheegid ama dukumeentiyada been ah ha muujin
scenarioData.streetWarrantJudicialDesc: Weydiiso hadii aad xor u tahay inaad tagto. Isticmaal xaqaaga aamusnaan. Dalbo qareen.
scenarioData.streetWarrantAdminDesc: Ha ordin. Ha been sheegid. Ha muujin dukumeentiyada been ah. Ha jirka iska caabin.
scenarioData.vehicleDesc: Xuquuqda inta lagu joojinayo gaariga ICE. Amar gelitaan vs fasax.
scenarioData.vehicleStep1Script: Gacmahaaga sug wadka. Shidka nalalka gudaha haddii habeenimo ay tahay.
scenarioData.vehicleStep1Explanation: Xasilli deggan oo la arko. Ha sameyn dhaqdhaqaaq degdeg ah.
scenarioData.vehicleStep2Explanation: Xaq ayaad u leedahay inaad ogaato sababta joojinta.
scenarioData.vehicleStep3Script: Waa kan laysanka wadista iyo diiwaan-gelinta.
scenarioData.vehicleStep3Explanation: Waa inaad bixisaa dukumentiyadaan haddii aad waddo. U sheeg saraakiisha ka hor inta aanad u soo qaadan.
scenarioData.vehicleStep4Script: Waxaan isticmaalayaa xaqa aamusnaan. Kama oggoli baaritaan kasta. Waxaan doonayaa inaan qareen la hadlo.
scenarioData.vehicleStep4Explanation: Uma baahnid inaad su'aalaha ka jawaabtid ka sokow bixinta laysanka iyo diiwaan-gelinta.
scenarioData.vehicleStep5Action: HADDII AAD KU TIDHI INUU KA BAXO
scenarioData.vehicleStep5Script: Xidh baabuurkaaga oo ha oggolaan baaritaan. Waxaad ka qaadi kartaa fiidiyow daaqadda dhexdeeda.
scenarioData.vehicleStep5Explanation: Haddii lagu yidhaahdo inaad ka baxdo, waa inaad ka dhigtid, laakiin waxaad diidi kartaa baaritaanka.
scenarioData.vehicleOverview: Inta lagu joojinayo waddo, waa inaad bixisaa laysankaaga wadista iyo diiwaan-gelinta baabuurka. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, waxaad leedahay xaqa aamusnaan ka sokow taas. Uma baahnid inaad oggolato baaritaanka baabuurka.
scenarioData.vehicleKeyPoint2: ✓ Bixiso laysanka iyo diiwaan-gelinta marka la weydiisto
scenarioData.vehicleKeyPoint3: ✓ U sheeg saraakiisha ka hor inta aanad dukumentiyadda u soo qaadan
scenarioData.vehicleKeyPoint4: ✓ Waxaad aamusi kartaa ka sokow aqoonsi aasaasi ah
scenarioData.vehicleKeyPoint5: ✓ Waxaad diidi kartaa fasaxa baaritaanka baabuurka
scenarioData.vehicleKeyPoint6: ✓ Dadka rakaabka ahi waxay weydiisan karaan hadii ay xor u yihiin inay tagaan

scenarioData.borderDesc: Xuquuqda meelaha laga soo galo iyo baaritaannada gudaha.
scenarioData.borderStep1Script: Meesha Laga Soo Galo (Port of Entry) vs. Baaritaanka Gudaha (Internal Checkpoint) - xeerarka kala duwan ayaa lagu dhaqmayaa.
scenarioData.borderStep1Explanation: Xadka, xuquuqyada way yar yihiin. Baaritaannada gudaha (100 mayl gudaheeda), ilaalinta dheeraad ah ayaad leedahay.
scenarioData.borderStep2Action: MEESHA LAGA SOO GALO (PORT OF ENTRY)
scenarioData.borderStep2Script: Ka jawaab su'aalaha aasaasiga ah ee ku saabsan muwaadinimaada. Waxaa laga yaabaa in lagaa baaro.
scenarioData.borderStep2Explanation: Xadka laftiisa, CBP waxay leedahay awood ballaaran.
scenarioData.borderStep3Script: Uma baahnid inaad ka jawaabtid su'aalaha ka sokow muwaadinimaada. Waxaad aamusi kartaa.
scenarioData.borderStep3Explanation: Baaritaannada gudaha (gudaha dalka) waxay leeyihiin xeerar kala duwan.
scenarioData.borderStep4Script: Ma waa la iga hayaa mise waan xor u ahay inaan aado? Waxaan isticmaalayaa xaqa aamusnaan.
scenarioData.borderStep4Explanation: Baaritaannada gudaha, waxaad caddeyn kartaa xuquuqda Taddiilka 5aad.
scenarioData.borderStep5Explanation: Xitaa baaritaannada, waxaad diidi kartaa fasaxa baaritaannada.
scenarioData.borderOverview: Waxaa jira laba nooc oo kulammada xadka ah: meelaha laga soo galo dhabta ah (xadka laftiisa) iyo baaritaannada gudaha (100 mayl gudaheeda xadka). Xuquuqdaadu way ka duwan yihiin meel kasta.
scenarioData.borderKeyPoint1: ✓ Meelaha laga soo galo: Xuquuqyada xaddidan, waa inaad ka jawaabtid su'aalaha muwaadinimaada

scenarioData.workplaceDesc: Booqashada ICE goobaha shaqada. Ha ordin, aamuso.
scenarioData.workplaceStep1Script: Orodku waxaa loo isticmaali karaa caddeyn kaa gees ah. Meeshaad joogto istaag.
scenarioData.workplaceStep1Explanation: Cararku waxaa loo isticmaali karaa caddeyn. Xasilli deggan.
scenarioData.workplaceStep2Script: Waxaan isticmaalayaa xaqa aamusnaan. Waxaan doonayaa inaan qareen la hadlo.
scenarioData.workplaceStep2Explanation: Waxaad leedahay xaqa aamusnaan goobta shaqada.
scenarioData.workplaceStep3Script: Kama oggoli in aan muujiyo dukumeentiyada iyadoon qareen la joogo.
scenarioData.workplaceStep3Explanation: Uma baahnid inaad ICE u muujiso dukumentiyadda fasaxa shaqada.
scenarioData.workplaceStep4Script: Miyaan xor u ahay inaan aado?

scenarioData.workplaceStep5Script: ICE waxay u baahan yihiin amar garsoorahanimo si ay u galaan meelaha aan dadweynaha ahayn ee goobta shaqada.
scenarioData.workplaceStep5Explanation: Meelaha gaarka ah ee goobta shaqada waxay leeyihiin ilaalinta la mid ah guriga.
scenarioData.workplaceOverview: ICE waxay soo booqan kartaa goobaha shaqada. Meelaha dadweynaha, waxay leeyihiin gelitaan dheeraad ah. Meelaha gaarka ah/aan dadweynaha ahayn, waxay u baahan yihiin amar garsoorahanimo. Waxaad leedahay xaqa aamusnaan iyo dalbasho qareen.

scenarioData.protestDesc: Hab-dhaqameedka ugu fiican iyo xuduudaha sharciga ah ee ururka nabdoon.
scenarioData.protestStep1Script: Waxaan si nabad ah ugu adeegsanayaa xaqa Taddiilka 1aad ee ururka.
scenarioData.protestStep1Explanation: Taddiilka 1aad wuxuu ilaaliyaa mudaaharaadka nabdoon meelaha dadweynaha.
scenarioData.protestStep2Script: Ku joog waddooyinka dadweynaha, beero, iyo goobaha dadweynaha. Ha xidhinin albaabbada ama waddooyinka.
scenarioData.protestStep2Explanation: Meelaha dadweynaha waa la ilaaliyaa. Hantida gaarka ahi waxay u baahan tahay ogolaansho.
scenarioData.protestStep3Script: Waxaan adeegsanayaa xaqa dastuurka ah ee ururka nabdoon. Ma waa la iga hayaa mise waan xor u ahay inaan aado?
scenarioData.protestStep3Explanation: Si deggan u cadee xuquuqdaada. Weydiiso hadii la ku haysto.
scenarioData.protestStep4Action: HADDII LA SIIYO AMAR KA BAXA
scenarioData.protestStep4Script: Xasuuso waqtiga, sababta la siiyay, oo ku dhaqan. Duub wax walba.
scenarioData.protestStep4Explanation: Ku fashilmida in laga baxa ka dib amar sharci ah waxay keeni kartaa xidhid.
scenarioData.protestStep5Script: Waxaan isticmaalayaa xaqa aamusnaan. Waxaan doonayaa qareen.
scenarioData.protestStep5Explanation: Ha iska caabin. Tag si jilicsan haddii loo baahdo. Cadee xuquuqdaada afka.
scenarioData.protestOverview: Taddiilka 1aad wuxuu ilaaliyaa xaqaaga inaad si nabad ah u uruurto oo aad mudaaharaaddo. Tani waxaa ka mid ah socodsiimo, isu soo baxa, iyo muujinta meelaha dadweynaha. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, waxaa jira xuduudaha sharciga ah oo aad fahmi karto.
scenarioData.protestKeyPoint1: ✓ Waxaad mudaaharaad ka samayn kartaa waddooyinka dadweynaha iyo beero
scenarioData.protestKeyPoint2: ✓ Waxaad sawiro qaadi kartaa oo aad duubi kartaa mudaaharaadaha
scenarioData.protestKeyPoint3: ✓ Booliska kuma joojin karaan mudaaharaadka iyadoo salka ku haysato waxyaabaha aad sheegtid
scenarioData.protestKeyPoint4: ✓ Waxaa laga yaabaa inaad u baahan tahay ruqsado ururada waaweyn ama xidhida waddooyinka
scenarioData.protestKeyPoint5: ✓ Mudaaharaadhayaasha gees ah ayaa leh xuquuqda la mid ah taada
scenarioData.protestKeyPoint6: ✓ Waxaa lagu xidhi karaa xidhida waddooyinka ama gashida hanti gaar ah
scenarioData.protestWarrantJudicialDesc: Ururka nabdoon, xambaarada, heesaha, socodsiimada waddooyinka dadweynaha, duubida.
scenarioData.protestWarrantAdminDesc: Dagaal, burburinta hantida, xidhida baabuurta degdegga ah, gashida hanti gaar ah.
scenarioData.recordingDesc: Goorma iyo sida aad si sharci ah u duubi karto hawlaha ICE.
scenarioData.recordingStep1Script: Waxaan isticmaalayaa xaqa Taddiilka 1aad ee duubida meel dadweyne ah.
scenarioData.recordingStep1Explanation: Duubista booliska iyo ICE meelaha dadweynaha waxaa ilaaliya dastuurka.
scenarioData.recordingStep2Script: Ka fog yaraan 10 cagood. Ha ku faragelin hawlahooda.
scenarioData.recordingStep2Explanation: Waxaad duubi kartaa laakiin ma awoodin hawlaha sharciga ka hortagga.
scenarioData.recordingStep3Script: Kama aan faragelinin. Waxaan ka duubayaa meel dadweyne ah taas oo ah xaqayga dastuurka ah.
scenarioData.recordingStep3Explanation: Si deggan u cadee xuquuqdaada. Ha murmin ama noqon muran.
scenarioData.recordingStep4Script: Isticmaal apps-ka si toos ah daruurta u soo raaciya. Ha tirininin duubitaanka haddii lagu yidhaahdo.
scenarioData.recordingStep4Explanation: Saraakiishu kuma qasbari karaan sharciga ahaan inaad tirtirto duubitaannada ama ay qaataan taleefankaaga iyadoon amar gelitaan la helin.
scenarioData.recordingStep5Script: Xasuuso: waqtiga, goobta, lambarada sharafka, wakaaladda, sharaxaada baabuurka, iyo ficillada la qaatay.
scenarioData.recordingStep5Explanation: Macluumaadkan wuxuu ka caawiyaa ilaalinta xubnaha bulshada iyo mas'uuliyad saarka wakaalado.
scenarioData.recordingOverview: Taddiilka 1aad wuxuu ilaaliyaa xaqaaga inaad duubto booliska iyo wakiillada ICE meelaha dadweynaha. Tani waxaa ka mid ah waddooyinka dadweynaha, beero, iyo meelaha kale ee dadweynaha. Kuma xidhi karaan kaliya duubista, laakiin waa inaadan ku faragelin waajibkooda.
scenarioData.recordingKeyPoint1: ✓ WAXAAD duubi kartaa sharciga meelaha dadweynaha
scenarioData.recordingKeyPoint2: ✓ Xafidi fogaan badbaado leh (10+ cagood la taliyay)
scenarioData.recordingKeyPoint3: ✓ Ha ku faragelin jirka ah hawlaha
scenarioData.recordingKeyPoint5: ✓ Saraakiishu waxay u baahan yihiin amar gelitaan si ay taleefankaaga u qaataan
scenarioData.recordingKeyPoint6: ✓ Daruurta si degdeg ah ugu kaydi duubitaanka
scenarioData.recordingWarrantJudicialDesc: Duub si furan meelaha dadweynaha. Cadee xuquuqdaada Taddiilka 1aad. Daruurta kaydi duubitaanka.
scenarioData.recordingWarrantAdminDesc: Ha ku faragelin. Ha galin hanti gaar ah. Ha ka hortaggin hawlaha.

faq.title: Su'aalaha Badanaa ee Bulshada
faq.subtitle: Jawaabaha su'aalaha caadiga ah ee ku saabsan SafeNeighbor, asturnaanta iyo badbaadadaada.
faq.generalA1: SafeNeighbor waa madal web oo asturnaanta hore u dhiga oo loo qorsheeyay in uu awood siiyo bulshada iyada oo loo marayo warbixinaha badbaadada ee waqtiga dhabta ah iyo waxbarashada xuquuqda madaniga. Waxaan bixinaa qalab lagu diiwaangeliyo howlaha fulinta sharciga iyo helitaanka qoraalada sharciga ee xaaladaha cadaadiska badan.
faq.generalA2: Maya. SafeNeighbor waa kheyraad madax-bannaan oo ay bulshadu hogaaminayso. Xiriir kama lihin hay'ad dawladeed iyo qaybta fulinta sharciga. Daacadnimadayadu waa oo dhan ku aaddan asturnaanta iyo badbaadada isticmaalayaashayada.
faq.generalQ3: Sidee bay u shaqeysaa khariidadda warbixinta?
faq.generalA3: Marka isticmaale arko dhaqdhaqaaq fulineed, wuxuu calaamadeyn karaa warbixin. Warbixintaas markaas waxay u muuqanaysaa isticmaaleyaasha kale ee aaggaas jooga, taasoo u saamaxaysa deriska inay go’aanno xog ogaal ah ka gaaraan safarkooda iyo badbaadadooda waqtiga dhabta ah. Warbixinnadu uma baahna xisaab, magac, iimayl ama lambarka taleefanka. Goobaha warbixinta waa la guudmariyaa ka hor kaydinta, waxaana la adeegsadaa xakameynno dhinaca server-ka ah si loo yareeyo spam iyo ku-takrifal. Metadata-ga shabakadda weli waa la farsameyn karaa si loo helo difaacyo hawlgal sida xaddididda heerka, laakiin laguma lifaaqo warbixinta dadweynaha ee isticmaaleyaasha kale arkaan.
faq.privacyTitle: Asturnaanta iyo amniga — Waxa SafeNeighbor ilaaliso
faq.privacyQ1: Miyaan u baahanahay inaan akoon sameysto si aan u isticmaalo SafeNeighbor?
faq.privacyA1: Maya. Kama dalbanayno magac, iimayl, lambar taleefan, ama gelitaanka baraha bulshada. Waxaad heli kartaa khariidadda iyo dhammaan qoraalada sharciga si buuxda oo qarsoodi ah.
faq.privacyQ2: Sidee baad u ilaalineysaa goobta aan joogo?
faq.privacyA2: Kuma raadraacayno. In kasta oo app-ku isticmaalayo GPS-ka qalabkaaga si uu kuugu muujiyo warbixinaha maxalliga ah, xogtaas waxaa lagu habeeya si maxalli ah oo taleefankaaga ah. Kuma kaydinayno taariikh-socodkaaga server-yadayada.
faq.privacyA3: SafeNeighbor waxay isticmaashaa laba qaab oo asturnaaneed oo kala duwan. Duubista, kaydka, iyo xogta kale ee xasaasiga ah ee qalabka waxaa ilaaliya sirgelin maxalli ah iyo furayaal aad adigu maamusho. Warbixinnada bulshada se waxay adeegsadaan qaab asturnaanta ilaaliya oo xogta yareeya: aqoonsiyada tooska ah waa la saaraa ka hor dirista, goobaha waa la guudmariyaa, mana jiro xisaab, magac, iimayl ama lambarka taleefanka oo looga baahan yahay adeegsiga khariidadda.
faq.privacyA4: Haa. Haddii aad isticmaasho barxadda si aad u diiwaangeliso la kulanka, faylka waxaa lagu kaydiyaa keydkaaga maxalliga ah ee sirgelsan, kayd kastaana waa la sirgeliyaa ka hor inta aan la dirin. Adiga ayaa haya furaha. Adigoon si cad u dooran inaad la wadaagto, duubistu ma noqonayso mid ay heli karaan dhinacyo saddexaad.
faq.legalQ1: Miyuu isticmaalka app-kan iga dhigayaa bartilmaameed?
faq.legalA1: Isticmaalka xuquuqdaada dastuuri ah iyo ogaanshaha waa sharci. Sababtoo ah ma soo ururinaynno macluumaadka aqoonsiga, isticmaalka app-ku ma abuuro raad dijitaal ah oo ku xira aqoonsigaaga howlahaaga.
faq.legalQ2: Miyay qoraalada "Ogow Xuquuqdaada" sharci ahaan kugu xidhanyihiin?
faq.legalA2: Qoraaladu waxay ku salaysan yihiin sharciga dastuuri ee la dhisay (sida Wax-ka-beddelka 4aad iyo 5aad). Si kastaba ha noqotee, waxay yihiin ujeeddooyin waxbarasho oo kaliya mana noqdaan talo sharci rasmi ah. Waxaan had iyo jeer kugu talinaa in aad la tashatid qareen xuquuqda madaniga ah kiisaska sharciga ee gaar ah.
faq.legalQ3: Maxaan sameeyaa haddii warbixin ay khaldan tahay?
faq.legalA3: Warbixinta bulshadu waxay ku tiirsantahay kalsoonida labada dhinac. Isticmaalayaashu waxay xaqiijin karaan ama calaamadayn karaan warbixinaha. Haddii warbixin ay heshaa calaamadaynno badan oo ah in aysan sax ahayn, si toos ah ayaa looga saaraa khariidadda si loo xaqiijiyo in bulshadu hesho macluumaadka ugu la aamini kara.
faq.philosophyQ1: Maxaa falsafadda Stoic bogga ku jirta?
faq.philosophyA1: Waxaan aaminsan nahay in badbaadadu u baahan tahay maskax cad. Mabaadi'da Stoic waxay na baraan in aan diiradda saarno waxa aan xakameyn karno — falalkeenna, diyaargarowgeenna, iyo waajibaadkeenna derisyadeenna — xitaa xaaladaha qas-qas leh.
faq.disclaimer: FAQ-gan waa ujeeddooyin macluumaad oo kaliya mana aha talo sharci. La tasho qareen laysansi leh xaaladaha sharciga ee gaar ah.
